Choose a page below to try common exercise types and see the corresponding
Quarto source. Every source example is collapsed until you choose **Show
source**.

::: {.callout-tip title="Trying the exercises"}
Type in the empty answer fields and select **Check**. Some exercises are hidden
under a clickable heading. For mathematical input, use forms such as `x^2`,
`2*x`, `sqrt(2)`, `sin(x)`, and `pi`; **Input help** provides a complete
reference. Graphical exercises explain directly which points or curves to move.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
All answer checking runs locally in the browser through SymPy and Pyodide.
AI-generated progressive feedback is optional and works with OpenAI-compatible
providers configured by the user.
:::
